CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 38

8. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 4

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 3

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 7

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

18. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

21. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

22. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 28

23. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

24. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
